behavior: A child selects one exact caller-authored command in a fresh context.
Acceptance requires a valid inference, the exact intermediate formula AST and the exact free-assumption set.
The original session goal is retained; require_complete additionally demands a closed original-goal certificate.
The parent helper independently rechecks the selected command and complete canonical receipt before adopting state.

compatibility.old_compiled_contracts: 16 fixtures for the five version-5 templates and eight version-6 proof_step fixtures remain exact.
compatibility.source_identity: The changed compiler is captured in execution pins; prepared route identities change.

deployment.rollback: Exact-postimage guarded bundle retained privately; reverse later layers first.

limits: A valid partial inference and an exact milestone are distinct from completing the original goal.
Distinct valid commands may satisfy the same obligation; this is not a unique proof representation.
Caller premises and decomposition remain explicit assumptions; no autonomous decomposition or empirical model-quality claim is made.
This release has no new real-model observations or measured overall cost improvement.

integrated_tests.scope: Final delegation/authoring/execution-pin checks, including actual CLI and operator API through fake providers and temporary stores.

live.malformed_scopes: compile returns HTTP 200 with ok:false, a scoped error and no executable source

validation.verification_correction: Initial smoke harness expected HTTP 400 for compile refusal; corrected to the existing inspect endpoint HTTP 200/ok:false contract. Production code was unchanged.
